tabNotes.d365: Ranked by recommendations, reviews and social posts
tabNotes.d90: Ranked by Instagram activity in the past 90 days
tabNotes.guidesTab: Ranked by independent recommendations, with newer articles counting for more
tabNotes.reviewsTab: Google and Tripadvisor combined, minimum 100 reviews

tagNote: The most-used tags across 1,459 Dubai posts from the past 12 months, with how many posts used each.

method.name: Recommendations
method.text: How many of 59 independent publishers named the cafe. Each counts once, and newer articles count for more. Sites selling property, travel or tickets don't count.

method.name: Reviews
method.text: Google and Tripadvisor ratings and review counts, with small counts pulled towards the average.

method.name: Talk
method.text: Instagram activity from people other than the cafe. One viral reel can't decide the chart.

method.name: Ads
method.text: Posts marked as an ad, gift or invite count for half.

method.name: Movement
method.text: How many places a cafe has risen or fallen since the last update.

limits: How far to trust this. It combines 87 cafes' Google and Tripadvisor ratings, 188 articles from 59 publishers and 1,459 public Instagram posts. Ratings come from Wanderlog's copies and may be months old. 20 newer cafes have no review data yet and are scored on their other signals. Older cafes have had longer to collect reviews and mentions, so the Trending tab is the better guide to what's new. TikTok, Reddit and private community groups aren't included, and shares and saves aren't public.
